gaps: completeness-1: PLAN.md §Work items W-6 (L51) — AC-6 requires the actual results of the task-162 restart and first checkpoint to be recorded, but W-6 only goes as far as "설치본 검증 명령 준비" (preparing the installed-copy verification commands). No Work item owns running S-9/S-10 after deploy approval, recording the results, or deciding where they are stored, so the implementer has to choose who records AC-6 evidence and where.

decision_clarity-1: PLAN.md §Findings 회귀 확인 (L20) + §Work items W-1 (L46) — Findings declares the adjacent consumers (canonical task path resolution, status·remove guards, hub briefing·Console) as "변경하지 않는" (not changed). W-1 only says "새 상태가 이 소비자의 허용 집합에 닿는지 조사" (investigate whether the new state reaches these consumers' allowed sets) and "영향 판정 기록" (record the impact judgment). The plan does not decide what to do if `recovery_required` is outside a consumer's allowed set: change that consumer (and who owns the file), reject the state, or stop and escalate. That choice is left to the implementer.

recoverability-1: PLAN.md §Release and recovery (L66) — the only failure path covers before install ("source 수정으로만 재시험", retest by source fixes only). There is no recovery path if the installed copy breaks Codex/Claude worktree boot after install (no rollback to the previous installed version or restore of settings). Recovery of the existing task-162 session is delegated to "`REQUEST.md` §162 복구 순서", but REQUEST.md is not in the task folder (bundle) TASK.md names, so the recovery steps cannot be checked from the plan.
